description: This file defines JSON serialization and deserialization options and functions for the internal go-json-experiment package, including MarshalOptions and UnmarshalOptions, with methods for marshaling and unmarshaling Go data to and from JSON.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a Go value as a JSON byte slice with default options.

methods.name: MarshalFull
methods.description: Serializes a Go value into an io.Writer with default options.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a Go value according to specified marshal and encode options.

methods.name: MarshalFull
methods.description: Serializes a Go value into an io.Writer according to specified options.

methods.name: MarshalNext
methods.description: Encodes a Go value as the next JSON value according to MarshalOptions.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON byte slice into a Go value with default options.

methods.name: UnmarshalFull
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data from an io.Reader into a Go value with default options.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a Go value according to specified unmarshal and decode options.

methods.name: UnmarshalFull
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data from an io.Reader into a Go value according to specified options.

methods.name: unmarshalFull
methods.description: Helper function to perform full unmarshaling with error handling.

methods.name: UnmarshalNext
methods.description: Decodes the next JSON value into a Go value according to UnmarshalOptions.
